bfitzy0725: The draft reached U-F13 on Day 10. Wendel "Rabbit" Bfitzy was shown which board tipped, which roof leaked and which promises to ignore.

A bullet went into Wendel "Rabbit" Bfitzy's chest just under the heart at U-F13. The medic said not to give him water, and then said nothing more. Shot by Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie of the Hegemony (@calmherculies500). Wendel "Rabbit" Bfitzy stood up to fix a loose sandbag at U-F13. He did not get to finish the job. Shot by Felix "Lucky" Calmherculie of the Hegemony (@calmherculies500).

The papers connected Roland Bfitzy to Wendel "Rabbit" Bfitzy. The men took longer to learn Roland Bfitzy's own habits, but they made the effort. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Roland Bfitzy watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
blokkhead2023: Pavel Blokkhead arrived on Day 11 and found the section asleep. The welcome had to wait until somebody needed the kettle. The Hegemony flag went up over Grey Mill. Pavel Blokkhead did not cheer. He sat down on a sandbag and ate his ration slowly, like a man with time again.
chavo.818: On Day 9, Valentin "Mud" Chavo arrived during an argument about a missing spoon. The war already had matters more urgent than introductions.

A single shot from across the wire hit Valentin "Mud" Chavo in the thigh at R-R18. He crawled the last yards on his elbows. Shot by Jonas "Doc" Angelogia of the Hegemony (@angelogia55). After the loss of Blackwater Canal, Valentin "Mud" Chavo helped stack spare sandbags at R-R18. Nobody asked when they would be needed.

Valentin "Mud" Chavo drifted in and out on the stretcher. Every time he woke, the line for the beds seemed longer. The Hegemony hold Grey Mill now, and they can see straight into R-R18. Valentin "Mud" Chavo has learned to walk bent double.
chieftain2155: Jonas "Brick" Chieftain arrived at T-F1 with a carefully folded uniform. The first low beam ruined the cap; the first puddle ruined the rest.
Blackwater Canal fell to the Hegemony. Jonas "Brick" Chieftain kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.

Frost made each footprint distinct. Jonas "Brick" Chieftain followed a trail to the missing ration sack and found the quartermaster sitting on it. Day 11: Grey Mill was lost. Jonas "Brick" Chieftain wrote down the news without trying to explain it.
crabbithesecond: In Greyhallow, Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec was a lamplighter. In S-R14, he is a number and a rifle. He has told everyone he intends to be a lamplighter again.

Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec fired at the flash of a shovel across the wire. Behind the shovel was Roland Valsteinne, now grazed. The sergeant read out the order: Blackwater Canal has fallen, hold the line. Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec looked at the new recruits coming up the road and counted them.

Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec was cleaning the rifle when a head showed across the wire. Load, aim, fire. Florian "Button" Thebaileebla was grazed. The company read out the roll of the First Thousand at the dawn watch. Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec answered to number 934. Day 11. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Otto "Hollow" Crabbithesec watched their flag go up on the heights and dug his trench a little deeper.
dylan47894: The sergeant gave Matthias "Smokes" Dylan a dead man's blanket and a living man's job. That is how replacements start, on Day 9 or any other.
Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Matthias "Smokes" Dylan stopped arguing about the next watch and went to check the stores.

Matthias "Smokes" Dylan measured a replacement beam three times in the narrow passage. Nobody wanted to be the one who got it wrong. The clerk counted the names twice. Matthias "Smokes" Dylan is number 665 of the first thousand to answer the call, and wears the ribbon of the First Thousand. The Hegemony won Grey Mill. In S-C8, Matthias "Smokes" Dylan listened to three explanations and trusted none of them.
elitecelebs_: Otto Elitecelebs found a place in S-F14 between a snorer and a man who talked in his sleep. The available alternative was under the leak.
Otto Elitecelebs was in the first hundred. The old hands in S-F14 call them 'the early birds', and not always kindly.

A bullet went through Otto Elitecelebs's sleeve at S-F14 and took some skin with it. He kept the sleeve. The Concord took Verdel Ridge. Otto Elitecelebs watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
The medics cleaned Otto Elitecelebs's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F14.
Otto Elitecelebs kept watch so that Leopold Shadowizard could sleep. Then Leopold kept watch so that Otto could. Neither slept.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. A bullet clipped Otto Elitecelebs's helmet at S-F14 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. The Hegemony took Hill 304, and the orders at S-F14 changed before the cheering ended. Otto Elitecelebs shouldered another load.
There were too few medics and too many wounded. Otto Elitecelebs waited too long, and the wound grew worse for it.
Otto Elitecelebs never saw the inside of the aid post. The medics changed his dressings on the stretcher until the wound closed. He is back on the line.
An enemy patrol scattered in front of S-F14. Otto Elitecelebs fired at the last man to run. Clement "Hollow" Killerdogman was grazed.
A bullet grazed Otto Elitecelebs's ribs at S-F14. He found the hole in his coat first and the wound second. Shot by Clement "Lucky" Johnrant of the Concord (@johnrant21).

Otto Elitecelebs walked back up the communication trench to S-F14, slower than before, but on his own feet. Blackwater Canal is in Hegemony hands. Otto Elitecelebs watched the map being corrected and wondered how such a small pencil mark could take so much work.

Otto Elitecelebs wrote to a fiancée who wears his ring on a chain. He did not mention the shelling. He mentioned the stars. News that the Hegemony had taken Grey Mill reached Otto Elitecelebs during supper. The same stew suddenly tasted better.
galvanooooo: Emil Galvanooooo reported to S-F11 with a pocket Bible with a hole in it sewn into his tunic lining. The sergeant pretended not to notice.
Emil Galvanooooo is one of the first hundred to answer the call. He wears the ribbon of the First Wave.
Emil Galvanooooo began repairing a blanket with scraps from ruined clothing. The first patch is a different colour from everything else.

Word of Emil Galvanooooo's blanket spread. A strip of lining and a square from an old scarf arrived without explanation. Verdel Ridge fell to the Concord. Emil Galvanooooo kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
A football came over the parapet from the Concord side with Bram "Hollow" Localfilipin's name scratched on it. Emil Galvanooooo kicked it back. It did not come again.

A bullet clipped Emil Galvanooooo's helmet at S-F11 and took a strip of scalp with it. He bled into his collar, swore, and lay low. Shot by Edmund "Smokes" Rry of the Concord (@c10ud_b3rry3.0). Mail came up the line with a letter for Emil Galvanooooo. Emil Galvanooooo read it in the dugout and kept the envelope.

Out on the wire with the wiring party. Emil Galvanooooo tore his hands on the barbs and did not make a sound. The new wire at S-F11 is up. Hill 304 fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Emil Galvanooooo helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
The medics cleaned Emil Galvanooooo's wound one last time and pronounced him fit. He is back to full duty at S-F11.
Emil Galvanooooo finished the blanket using six kinds of cloth. The men can identify most of the donors by the patches alone.
The patched blanket kept Emil Galvanooooo warm through the night. In the morning, a neighbour arrived with another torn blanket and an optimistic expression.
The corporal found out Emil Galvanooooo used to be a fisherman. Emil Galvanooooo has been doing two jobs ever since.

The Concord sentry, Edmund "Hollow" Biwott, shouted once. Emil Galvanooooo silenced the shout with the flat of a shovel and was back over the parapet a minute later. (@a_k_biwott) The flare went up just as Emil Galvanooooo reached the Concord parapet. Emil Galvanooooo jumped down first. Oskar Pearson was the man waiting there, and Oskar Pearson fell. (@_william.pearson_) The raid was quick, the way back was not. Emil Galvanooooo snagged on the wire and took a bullet before the others pulled Emil Galvanooooo free. Blackwater Canal has been won. Emil Galvanooooo listened as the corporal read the news twice, once for the men just off watch.

Back on the fire step at S-F11. Emil Galvanooooo says the wound itches, which the medics say is a good sign. Day 11. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. From the heights Emil Galvanooooo could see the whole Concord line, and for the first time the war looked winnable.
gdot08: Roland Gdot arrived with the Day 11 draft, carrying a pressed cornflower and the news from home, which was old by the time he told it. Victory at Grey Mill. Roland Gdot let himself talk about leave for the first time in days.
ilhanrae: Albin Ilhanrae arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a lock of hair in a matchbox and a borrowed coat two sizes too big.

Edmund Edhi and Albin Ilhanrae cooked a stew from everything in their pockets: one onion, two biscuits and a button. They ate all of it except the button. The Hegemony took Grey Mill. Albin Ilhanrae watched the officer move a pin on the map and ask for more digging tools.
jai_jib: Albin Jib signed the papers with a steady hand. The trench at S-S16 took him in like it takes everyone: without a word.
The last of the jam was shared by adding hot water and calling it a drink. Albin Jib approved the method.

Albin Jib was hit through the chest at S-S16. He is breathing. That is all the medic would say. Shot by Quentin Dorufotograf of the Hegemony (@dorufotograful). Albin Jib smelled the enemy cooking before seeing anyone. Then Zeno "Owl" Wyatthohbein came out for a cup and was badly wounded. A rifle cracked from the far side of no man's land. Albin Jib fell at S-S16 and never moved again. Shot by Quentin Dorufotograf of the Hegemony (@dorufotograful).
The papers say Dietrich Jib. The sergeant says he has his father's eyes. Albin Jib's eyes. Nobody in S-S16 argues.

Dietrich Jib wrote letters for men who could not write, and some for men who could but did not know the words. A thousand names now stand in the regimental book. Dietrich Jib is number 568. The sergeant pinned the ribbon of the First Thousand on without a speech. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony. Dietrich Jib kept the newspaper; he wanted to remember exactly what had been promised beforehand.
mangotto.id: Emil "Crow" Mangotto unpacked a child's drawing of a horse at R-R11. The man in the next bunk shifted his bag to make room without asking what it was. Emil "Crow" Mangotto's transfer to the role of sapper was approved. The quartermaster wanted every borrowed item back before issuing anything else.

The Hegemony secured Blackwater Canal. Emil "Crow" Mangotto helped pass the news along the line, checking each time that he had heard correctly. A letter from home found Emil "Crow" Mangotto before the night shift. Emil "Crow" Mangotto folded it small and kept it close.

Emil "Crow" Mangotto had just lit a cigarette at R-R11 when a bullet cut a line across his cheek. He finished the cigarette before going to the medic. Shot by Pavel Mcm of the Concord (@joe_mcm09). A letter from home found Emil "Crow" Mangotto before the night shift. Emil "Crow" Mangotto folded it small and kept it close. The report confirmed the Hegemony victory at Grey Mill. Emil "Crow" Mangotto folded the paper so the headline stayed on the outside.
patriot_tony: Roland Tony arrived with the evening ration party, carrying a bullet that missed him and a borrowed coat two sizes too big. The transfer made Roland Tony a signaller. He spent the first hour learning where everything belonged, including himself.

Roland Tony mended a split glove with pale thread. One finger now looks like it has been promoted. A letter from home found Roland Tony before the night shift. Roland Tony folded it small and kept it close. Grey Mill fell to the Hegemony at dusk. Roland Tony helped drag the guns up the slope and slept that night on ground nobody else had held for years.
